Camera Enhanced View loads these assets locally on demand.

- YOLOP 640 × 640 ONNX model from https://github.com/hustvl/YOLOP/blob/main/weights/yolop-640-640.onnx (YOLOP-LICENSE).
- ONNX Runtime Web 1.22.0, single-threaded WASM execution using the files distributed in the npm package onnxruntime-web (ORT-LICENSE and ORT-NOTICES).
